title: glebionis segetum
intro: Glebionis segetum, commonly known as Corn Marigold or Chrysanthemum segetum, is an annual flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is known for its bright yellow and orange flowers, which have been traditionally used in herbal medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Glebionis segetum include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever, while also exhibiting antiviral and antimicrobial actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects.
